native.codex_version_synced: Sync complete. Any manually pinned version remains unchanged.
native.codex_version_save_first: Save or discard your changes before syncing.
native.usage_hint: Persistent usage and cost estimates across restarts. Input includes cache; output includes reasoning.
native.requests_hint: Filter provider attempts and inspect usage details. Export the complete selected range.
native.health_hint: Observed CPA runtime state, with no extra model requests. No observation means unknown.
native.actions_hint: Review credential errors manually. Changing an issue status does not disable, restore or delete credentials.
native.prices_hint: USD per million tokens. Use * for any provider or tier; model must match exactly. Higher context thresholds apply from that input size. Changes affect future requests only. Zero explicitly means free.
native.modules_hint: Switch features independently; settings persist and take effect immediately. Disabling a module preserves its history.
native.disabled_hint: Enable this feature in module settings.
native.unavailable: Enable native-management in CPA configuration and restart to use these features.
native.attempt_note: Counts are provider attempts, including retries.
native.trend_hint: Green: successful attempts. Red: failed attempts. Empty periods stay on the time axis. Buckets use UTC; labels use your local time.
native.truncated: Result limit reached; narrow the time range.
native.export_limit: Export exceeds 50,000 records or 64 MiB; narrow the time range.
native.snapshots_hint: Latest 200 snapshots. Recorded every 15 minutes and on demand.
native.no_prices: No price rules. Requests remain unpriced until a matching rule is configured.
native.module_history_hint: Persist requests, token usage, aggregates and key labels.
native.module_pricing_hint: Apply explicit model prices to future request records. History is needed to retain estimates.
native.module_accounts_hint: Record runtime snapshots and credential issues for manual review.
native.automation_off: Automatic credential changes are off. Storage counters reset on restart; history is retained.
native.percentile_hint: Exact nearest-rank percentiles from successful attempts with observed timings. TTFT includes streaming samples only. Unknown timings are excluded; zero observed milliseconds remains a valid sample.
native.rate_hint: RPM and TPM use the full selected time window and count provider attempts, including retries. Cache share is cache-read tokens divided by input tokens.
native.module_diagnostics_hint: Observe final downstream POST outcomes and correlate provider attempts. Does not change routing, retries or account state.
native.diagnostics_hint: One row per observed downstream POST request. Expand a request to see related provider attempts; authentication failures may have no attempts.
native.diagnostics_caveat: HTTP completion alone does not prove model success. Stream inspection detects supported error frames; oversized or unsupported data is marked partial. No request or response bodies are stored. WebSocket requests are not observed here.
native.diagnostics_loss: Observations lost this run: queue overflow {{dropped}}, write failures {{failed}}.
native.timeline_hint: Ordered by observed attempt start, then record sequence. Overlapping attempts are not a serial replay. Only reported attempts appear; missing upstream IDs or legacy records are not inferred.
native.observation_unavailable: No downstream observation available: this may be a legacy record, an excluded endpoint, disabled diagnostics, or an expired / lost observation.
native.copy_failed: Copy failed; select and copy the displayed value.
native.invalid_filters: Enter both custom dates, end after start (up to 366 days), and minimum duration no greater than maximum.
native.history_filter_hint: Custom dates override the preset after Apply. Model matching is exact. Export uses the applied filters across all pages, with a fixed record watermark; it excludes later arrivals.
native.models_truncated: Showing the 500 most frequent models; you can still enter any exact model name.
native.catalog_hint: Download a versioned LiteLLM-compatible price catalog. Supports fast/priority, flex, batch and dynamic long-context thresholds. Local rules override catalog prices. Missing rates or ambiguous cache-write TTL remain unpriced. These are estimates, not provider billing receipts.
native.catalog_synced: Catalog updated; applies to future attempts.
native.catalog_save_first: Save settings before synchronizing this source.
native.downstream_note: Counts downstream requests; one request may include multiple provider attempts.
native.module_limits_hint: Per caller key and upstream credential admission. Zero means unlimited; counters are local to this CPA process.
native.module_headers_hint: Remove proxy information, with an option to keep the client's software identity. Off by default for each account.
native.headers_client: Remove proxy information + keep client identity
native.headers_off_hint: No extra proxy-header cleanup. Global CLI version settings on the Modules page still apply.
native.headers_clean_hint: Remove headers carrying forwarding IPs and proxy-chain details. Software name, version and OS still follow CPA's existing settings.
native.headers_client_hint: Clean proxy information, then keep the software name, version and OS supplied by the client. Incomplete identity falls back to CPA defaults; a missing version stays absent.
native.headers_identity_hint: Client identity means software information, not the login account. The OAuth account stays the same. Fingerprint settings control device and conversation IDs separately.
native.module_wire_hint: Send Codex OAuth traffic with the official CLI's TLS handshake, HTTP/2 preface, header order, zstd body and cookies. Off by default for each account.
native.wire_off: Off (default): CPA's Chrome-style TLS and Go HTTP/2
native.wire_off_hint: Upstream connections keep CPA's existing transport. Nothing else changes.
native.wire_codex_hint: Connections to chatgpt.com use the TLS ClientHello, HTTP/2 SETTINGS, header order and connection reuse captured from codex-cli 0.154.0. Request content, model, identifiers and account are unchanged.
native.wire_compress: Compress request bodies with zstd like the CLI
native.wire_cookies: Keep and replay upstream cookies for this account
native.wire_routing_hint: Add x-codex-routing-hint from the requested model when the client did not send one
native.wire_stats: Open connections: {{open}} · reused: {{reused}} · dials: {{dials}} · compressed: {{compressed}} · cookies: {{cookies}}
native.wire_profile_hint: Compiled-in values reproduced by the wire module. They are version-specific; recapture when the official client's network stack changes. This page does not modify anything.
native.wire_scope_hint: Applies only to this account's connections to chatgpt.com over HTTP and WebSocket. API-key credentials and other providers are unaffected. Software identity comes from Header normalization; device and conversation IDs come from Fingerprint convergence.
native.wire_setup_title: How to use for your own Codex accounts
native.wire_setup_hint: Recommended combination for accounts you use yourself. It reproduces the official CLI on the wire and does not change model, request content or quota.
native.wire_setup_step_affinity: Config → Routing: enable session affinity so one conversation stays on one account instead of rotating.
native.wire_setup_step_headers: Header normalization → “Strip proxy info + keep client identity”, so the software identity is the one your client sends, not a fixed macOS codex-tui.
native.wire_setup_step_fingerprint: Fingerprint convergence → “Device ID only”. Do not use “Session” or “Full”: they rewrite conversation IDs, which is the setting people associate with quota drops.
native.wire_setup_step_wire: Wire profile → “Official Codex CLI profile” (this page). Only the TLS handshake, HTTP/2 framing, header order, zstd body and cookies change.
native.wire_setup_safety: None of these touch the model, prompt, sampling or account. If a response looks wrong, switch this profile back to Off first; nothing else needs to change.
native.wire_recommend_hint: Works best together with session affinity, Header normalization in “keep client identity” mode and Fingerprint convergence in “Device ID only” mode. See the Modules page for the full guide.
native.wire_profile_verified_value: Accepted by the real chatgpt.com edge over HTTP/2 through Cloudflare (GET and zstd POST). ClientHello, HTTP/2 preface, header order and zstd frame header compared byte for byte against the official CLI.
native.disguise_hint: One place for everything that makes proxied Codex OAuth accounts look like the official CLI: software identity, device ID, wire profile and session affinity. Nothing here changes the model, prompt or quota.
native.disguise_all_good: Everything is on. Every Codex OAuth account below uses the recommended combination.
native.disguise_not_ready: Not fully applied yet: {{matching}} of {{total}} accounts match the recommended combination. Use “Apply recommended to all”.
native.disguise_applied: Recommended combination applied to every account.
native.disguise_reset_done: All per-account policies set back to Off. Modules and session affinity were left as they are.
native.disguise_affinity_hint: Writes routing.session-affinity in config.yaml. One conversation stays on one account instead of rotating.
native.disguise_accounts_hint: Each row is one account. Changing a value saves immediately. Recommended: “Strip proxy info + keep client identity”, “Device ID only”, “Official Codex CLI profile”.
native.disguise_accounts_empty: No Codex OAuth credentials found. Log in to a Codex account under Auth Files first.
native.disguise_accounts_not_loaded: Codex credentials exist but the server has not loaded them yet. Refresh in a moment.
native.disguise_modules_link_hint: Per-account switches, session affinity, the setup guide and the wire profile reference all live on one page.
native.module_fingerprint_hint: Give each account a fixed device ID and choose whether conversations share IDs. Off by default for each account.
native.credential_controls: Usage profiles, access policies and request settings
native.controls_save_first: Save this credential first, then reopen its editor to configure native policies.
native.controls_independent: These settings are saved separately and take effect immediately. Changing a key, base URL or filename may create a new credential identity; configure its policy after saving.
native.client_limits_hint: Zero = unlimited. RPM counts accepted requests in a rolling 60-second window. Concurrency covers the full request; WebSockets hold one slot per connection. Counters reset on restart and are not shared across CPA instances.
native.credential_limits_hint: Zero = unlimited. RPM counts actual provider attempts, including retries. Streams hold concurrency until upstream completion. Busy credentials allow fallback without changing health or cooldowns. Counters reset on restart.
native.fingerprint_session: Shared device and session, separate conversations
native.fingerprint_full: Shared device, session and conversation IDs
native.fingerprint_off_hint: Use CPA's existing behavior without unifying device or conversation IDs.
native.fingerprint_device_hint: Use one fixed device ID per account. Keep the original session and conversation IDs.
native.fingerprint_session_hint: Share device and session IDs within an account. Different calling keys or original conversations still get different conversation IDs.
native.fingerprint_full_hint: Every conversation on this account shares device, session and conversation IDs. Choose separate conversations if they need distinct IDs.
native.catalog_lookup_hint: Exact catalog model name. USD per million tokens; unknown prices are shown as —. Actual response tier wins; OpenAI fast and priority are aliases. No fixed long-context multiplier is assumed.
native.catalog_empty: No prices found for this exact model name.
native.risk_hint: Review text, code and tool arguments before forwarding. Off by default; configured inside CPA.
native.risk_models: Exact model names, one per line
native.risk_latestTurnOnly: Review latest user turn and subsequent tool results
native.risk_sessionBlock: Block this key's session after upstream cyber_policy
native.risk_policy_hint: Blocking waits for the complete review. Observe uses a bounded asynchronous queue and does not stop forwarding. Latest-turn review reduces coverage.
native.risk_no_rules: No local rules. Use a review model for semantic and code safety checks.
native.risk_threshold_hint: Scores at or above the threshold are blocked; unspecified categories use 0.8. Explicit unsafe verdicts remain blocked. Qwen3Guard controversial verdicts are flagged by default.
native.risk_endpoint_hint: Endpoints are tried in order on failure. Text is sent only to your configured reviewer. Tokens are encrypted and never returned. Include /v1 in the URL.
native.risk_mode_hint: Off bypasses review; observe only records; blocking forwards after approval. Upstream cyber_policy is preserved. Session blocks are scoped to a key; credentials are never automatically disabled.
native.risk_event_privacy: Events contain categories, rules, hashes and request links, never raw prompts, code or secrets. Passed events require the record-pass option.
native.risk_blocks_hint: Blocks expire automatically and can be removed individually. Hashes are scoped to policy versions and sessions to calling keys. Disabled options bypass their lists.
native.risk_test_hint: Test saved policy or a selected reviewer. Does not call the generation upstream or add blocks. Running tests can be cancelled.
native.module_risk_hint: Rules, model review, events and session blocks. The review mode stays off until configured.
native.module_inventory_hint: Durable counters, annotations, tags, expiry and model rules. Disabling pauses collection and enforcement but retains data.
native.profile_models: Allowed models (one per line; empty = unrestricted)
native.profile_hint: Saved separately from credential JSON. Key models match client names; credential models match upstream names. Budget is advisory, not exact billing or a hard cap. Replacing a key does not transfer its profile.
native.inventory_load_failed: Could not load usage; refresh to retry
native.inventory_quota_hint: Refresh account quota or complete a request with quota signals to show window estimates.
native.inventory_estimate_hint: Window cost ÷ used fraction. Model mix affects the estimate; this is not an official dollar quota.
native.inventory_reason_expired_snapshot: Window reset; awaiting a fresh snapshot
native.inventory_reason_stale_snapshot: Quota snapshot is over 15 minutes old; refresh
native.inventory_reason_no_priced_usage: No priced usage in this window
native.inventory_reason_unpriced_requests: Unpriced requests prevent a balance estimate
native.inventory_hint: Search annotations and usage together. Counters survive history retention and include only recorded upstream attempts. Create keys in the original settings panel.
native.inventory_search: Search name, notes, tags or ID
native.insight_intro: Volume and health first, then trends and sources. Each retry counts as an upstream attempt within the selected period.
native.insight_pricing_gap: {{count}} requests are not fully priced; cost includes only known amounts.
native.insight_trend_hint: Switch requests, tokens or cost; hover for details. Empty intervals are zero-filled. Cost includes priced usage only.
native.insight_token_hint: Cache tokens are included in input; reasoning tokens in output. They are not added twice.
native.insight_performance_details: Expand latency distribution, percentiles and performance
